fileLines: description: List what I'd need to know
Before I decide this, scout the ground:
Don't give me an answer. Give me the map
of what I don't yet know.
termArg: adding an AI chatbot to our B2B analytics dashboard
responseLines: Settle it: do users ask 'why', not just 'what'?
Cheap test: Wizard-of-Oz it — human answers, 5 accounts, 2 weeks.
Point of no return: once sales pitches it, ripping it out burns trust.
Hidden cost: per-query LLM spend at scale — margin killer?
Real question: customer pull, or competitor-checkbox reflex?
